_readme: Airbus autoflight panels are driven by pushing and pulling knobs, not by
setting a value alone: a value is SELECTED by pulling the knob and MANAGED
by pushing it. Those pushes and pulls are HTML gauge events (H: events),
which SimConnect cannot send directly -- they go through the WASM bridge as
Each entry below is one naming convention. Which aircraft uses which is set
VERIFY BEFORE TRUSTING: 'flybywire' is the documented A32NX convention and
is used by aircraft built on that codebase. The iniBuilds entries are
deliberately EMPTY -- their internal event names are not published, and
guessing them would produce commands that silently do nothing. With no
convention the adapter falls back to standard SimConnect events, which those
aircraft do respond to for heading, altitude, speed and approach.
To fill one in for your aircraft: run 'python -m aipilot lvars --scan' with
the aeroplane loaded, move the FCU knob you care about, and watch which
variable changes. Add it here and it takes effect on the next run.
